name: Radar (Dish)
description: This fixed sensor outputs the distance and angle to a detected object within its range and field of view using radio waves. (Range : 20000) (Max FOV : 0.125)
shortDescription: A medium range, fixed rotation Radar that returns information about a detected object within its view.

logicNodes.label: Target Found
logicNodes.description: Returns if an object has been detected.

logicNodes.label: FOV
logicNodes.description: The sensor's yaw field of view in turns from 0.01 to 0.125.

logicNodes.label: Target Distance
logicNodes.description: The distance to the target in meters.

logicNodes.label: Signal Strength
logicNodes.description: The strength of the returned signal.

logicNodes.label: Elevation Angle
logicNodes.description: The pitch angle between the sensor and the target in turns.
